parameters.label: Fragments
parameters.help: How many ejecta fragments the impact launches.

parameters.label: Simulated time
parameters.help: Total time to propagate. Frame count is years / output step.

parameters.label: Output step
parameters.help: How often a frame is written. This sets replay size, not accuracy.

parameters.label: Substeps per frame
parameters.help: Integrator steps inside each frame. Accuracy depends on dt/substeps, so raise this with the output step to keep fidelity.

parameters.label: Ejection speed (min)
parameters.help: Lower bound of ejection speed. Default is Mars escape velocity.

parameters.label: Ejection speed (max)
parameters.help: Upper bound of the power-law velocity distribution.

parameters.label: Ejecta cone
parameters.help: Half-angle of the cone the fragments are launched into.

parameters.label: Fragment radius (min)
parameters.help: Lower bound of the power-law fragment size distribution.

parameters.label: Fragment radius (max)
parameters.help: Upper bound of the power-law fragment size distribution.

parameters.label: Size distribution slope
parameters.help: How steeply small fragments outnumber large ones. At 2 there are about a hundred times more 1 mm stones than 10 cm ones. This decides whether anything in the swarm is big enough for rock to shield it.

parameters.label: Biological core
parameters.help: Mass fraction of the fragment occupied by the microbial payload.

parameters.label: Dust flux
parameters.help: Incident dust mass flux that drives erosion.

parameters.label: Random seed
parameters.help: Same seed gives the same swarm. Change it to resample. Type an exact value to reproduce a published run.

parameters.label: Radiation pressure
parameters.help: REBOUNDx radiation force on each fragment.

parameters.label: Dust erosion
parameters.help: Shrink fragments as they sweep up dust.

parameters.label: Planets
parameters.help: Include the eight planets in the N-body system.
